header.nextService.titleComplete: Every departure service has completed or was skipped.
header.nextService.titleNotStarted: The departure sequence has not started yet (it starts with the flight plan, or from Settings → Ground Services).
header.nextService.titleHolding: Call {0} now, bypassing its activation rule (INT/RAD). Holding: {1}
header.nextService.titleNext: Call the next departure service now, bypassing its activation rule (INT/RAD).

voice.title: Voice reference — every phrase the FO, ground crew, cabin crew and ATC understand

settings.title: Settings
settings.showAdvanced.title: Reveal the tuning fields (timeouts, intervals, thresholds) on every settings page

pillarOff.gsx: GSX ground services are switched off.
pillarOff.speech: The voice First Officer is switched off.

profileBanner.saves: Saving on these pages stores the ground-services settings in that profile.

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language of every page, for every browser that opens the app
language.label: Language
language.fieldHint: Applies at once, on the sim PC and the tablet. Numbers, weights and times keep the aviation formats whatever the language. The voice First Officer and the logs stay English.
language.packsHint: Each language is one JSON file in {0}. Add your own ({1}) or correct a text there; the folder is read again on the next page draw. Anything a language lacks is shown in English.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Click a theme to apply it now. Your own JSON themes in the user config folder appear after the built-in ones.
theme.logoTitle: PNG, SVG, JPG or WEBP up to 512 KB — shown in the header while this theme is active
theme.logosHintBefore: Logos are your own files. They stay on this PC in
theme.logosHintAfter: and are never part of the app or the installer. The header shows the active theme's logo when one is set.

header.title: Header
header.hint: What the top bar shows on every page

nextService.label: Show NEXT SERVICE button in the header
nextService.hint: Calls the next departure service now — the INT/RAD smart button, on every page.
nextService.more: The button names the next service and why it is holding. It is greyed until the departure sequence has started, and after it completes. Same action as Settings → Ground Services → Call next service now, the Stream Deck button and the voice command 'next service'.

screen.title: Screen & Install
screen.hint: For this device only — the tablet or PC you are reading this on

keepAwake.label: Keep the screen awake
keepAwake.hint: Stops this device's screen from sleeping while the app is open. Stored on this device only.
keepAwake.needsHttps: Only a secure page can keep the screen awake. Open the app over HTTPS —
keepAwake.moreNotSupported: This browser has no Screen Wake Lock. Safari 16.4+, Chrome and Edge have it; a secure page is still required.
keepAwake.more: The browser drops the lock when the page is hidden and the app takes it again when you come back. A low battery can make the browser refuse — the pill then reads REQUESTING until the next try.

install.label: Install as an app
install.hint: Add ProsimCompanion to the home screen for a full-screen app without the browser bars.
install.more: iPad: open the app in Safari, tap Share, then 'Add to Home Screen'. Android / Chrome: menu → 'Install app'. There is no offline mode — the app needs the sim PC. Full steps: docs/manual/07-tablet-install.md in the install folder.

screen.perAddress: The switch is stored per address: on at {0} does not carry over from {1}. iPadOS ignores every wake lock in Low Power Mode.

diag.osOverride: If the screen still sleeps with the pill ACTIVE and no release shown, the OS overrode the lock (Low Power Mode, or Guided Access / a Screen Time limit).

airline.title: Airline logos
airline.hint: For the pop-out Flight Monitor board — matched to the flight plan's airline code
airline.logoTitle: PNG, SVG, JPG or WEBP up to 512 KB — shown on the Flight Monitor when the OFP's airline matches
airline.none: No airline logos yet. Type the airline's ICAO code (the one SimBrief shows, e.g. KLM, BAW, DLH) and add its logo.
airline.storedAfter: , never part of the app. The Flight Monitor shows the logo whose code equals the OFP's airline code; without one it shows the code itself.
airline.codeFirst: Type the airline's 2–4 character code first (e.g. KLM).
